text:
Maria SRE: quick follow-up from the PM postmortem — we surfaced three recurring capacity patterns and a set of remediation items. need owners and realistic ETAs.
Ajay Infra: ack. can you paste the three patterns so folks have the context?
Maria SRE: sure — 1) quota exhaustion during bursty PLG spikes, 2) scheduler backpressure causing long tail latencies, 3) headroom erosion overnight from long-running batches.
Sean Runtime: thanks. suggesting owners: quota backstop -> Ajay, scheduler tuning -> Sean + infra, headroom planning -> Maria + product.
Lia Product: ok to co-own headroom planning. i'll prioritize workload profiles and set of traffic SLAs. ETA for initial plan: 2026-04-08.
Ajay Infra: for quota backstop i'm proposing two things: enforce per-tenant soft caps, and a short-circuit fallback to lower-cost model variant when cap hit. will draft proposal by 2026-03-31.
Maria SRE: scheduler tuning tasks: (a) increase preemption sensitivity, (b) tune burst queue size, (c) add metrics for scheduling wait-time percentiles. Sean — can you open a single PR with knobs and a dashboard stub?
Sean Runtime: yep. PR will include a config flag `scheduler.burst_queue_size` and a metric `scheduling.wait_p95_ms`. aiming for draft PR by 2026-03-29.
ops-bot: ACTION CREATED: #A-4821 quota-backstop design assigned to Ajay Infra, due 2026-03-31
ops-bot: ACTION CREATED: #A-4822 scheduler-tuning PR assigned to Sean Runtime, due 2026-03-29
Maria SRE: we also need a runbook update: add a rapid fallback flow that ops can trigger (region failover + model-variant fallback). owner?
Ajay Infra: i can take the runbook draft w/ Maria. i'll put a checklist in the doc: steps, Slack shortcuts, and monitoring playbook. target 2026-04-05.
Lia Product: for headroom planning i'll provide historical usage slices and a recommended safety factor (initially 1.25x). will share dataset and assumptions by 2026-03-28.
Sean Runtime: question — do we want automatic ramp-up of reserved pools overnight or keep manual approvals? automatic would help but needs quota guardrails.
Maria SRE: prefer staged automation: start with scheduled policy + manual override. add a canary step to detect noisy tenants.
Ajay Infra: i'll prototype a quota backstop policy that sets `quota_mode=soft` and a cooldown window. will include CLI snippet in PR: ```redwood quota set --tenant T123 --mode soft --cooldown 2h```
Lia Product: can we also add an eval to ensure quality doesn't degrade when falling back to cheaper variant? i'll own that eval prompt set.
ops-bot: NOTE: recurring follow-up weekly on Tuesdays 09:30 PT starting 2026-03-30 added to #incidents calendar
Maria SRE: nice. final ask — each owner paste a one-line status in the thread by EOD tomorrow so we can escalate if blocked. :thumbsup:
Ajay Infra: will do.
Sean Runtime: will do.
Lia Product: will do.
